body:
I noticed this as well, while testing your previous issue about `reload_scene_from_path`.
On my side, it switches scene tab to the reloaded scene, if and only if before the reload, the currently edited scene is the last one in the scene tab bar.

EDIT: issues that may be related:
- Editor window title flashes if a scene is reloaded, even if it's exactly the scene currently editing
- If the scene currently editing is heavy, which takes a while to switch to and from, then reloading even a simple scene has noticeable lag, even if in the end the tab is not changed. Feels like a roundtrip that ends up being NOP.
- (this is likely not related but I'll leave it here for now) If you reload a different scene in the middle of drag transforming a node in the 2D editor, and then after the reload finishes, release the mouse button to commit the change, you'll notice that the scene you just edited is not marked as unsaved with an asterisk. Closing its scene tab also won't prompt you to save. And if you then reopen the scene, you'll find out that it's indeed not saved. Subsequent edits that are not "interrupted" by a reload are still fine.
